min_supported_version.description: F25 forced update. Installed versionName below this sees a blocking Update required screen. Empty = no floor. Use dotted numbers (1.2.0); an unparseable value is ignored (fail-open).

latest_version.description: F25 soft nudge. Installed versionName below this (and not below min_supported_version) sees a dismissible update banner. Empty = no nudge.

ai_stylist_enabled.description: F25 feature flag, reserved for the LLM-provider feature. No app code reads it yet.

premium_enabled.description: F25 feature flag, reserved for the RevenueCat feature. No app code reads it yet.

maintenance_message.description: F25 maintenance notice. Non-blank text shows a dismissible banner at the top of the app. Empty = none. Public to every client: never put secrets here.
